name: Elcano

description.title: Elcano™ - Large Fruit, High Firmness Short Day Strawberry
paragraphs: Elcano™ (CBC027) is a short-day strawberry variety developed by California Berry Cultivars with excellent performance under macrotunnels in Huelva, Spain and central Mexico. It produces extra-large, firm fruit with 9–11 °Brix on average — among the highest values of all materials evaluated, reaching up to 14 in juice fruit.

In Huelva trials, Elcano™ accumulated 1,317 g/plant from January through April of the 2026 season (in progress), following a complete 2025 season of 1,335 g/plant with a March peak of 484 g/plant. In Zamora, Michoacán, Elcano™ outperformed Bounty by more than 35% on yield during December.

Fruit averages 36–38 grams — extra large and very uniform — with firmness of 1.01–1.09 lb/in² for excellent shelf life. Appearance scores are consistent across plots, and the variety performs reliably under macrotunnel production.

Elcano™ offers real flexibility: plant plugs for early harvest or bare root for larger fruit late in the cycle. Recommended spacing is 35 cm, which delivered 28% higher yield than 23 cm in Huelva. Available through CBC and Eurosemillas.
